ActionResource.description: Single Photoshop action resource (.atn or inline actionJSON). When present, the 'source' field is required.

actionName.description: The name of a specific action to execute within the action set. If omitted, all actions in the file are executed.

source.description: Source for the action. Can be external file reference or inline actionJSON content. Inline actionJSON can use placeholders `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_0__`, `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_1__`, etc. which will be replaced at runtime with the file paths of the corresponding additional images. Legacy format `ACTION_JSON_OPTIONS_ADDITIONAL_IMAGES_0` is also supported for backward compatibility.

actions.description: List of Photoshop actions. Can be .atn files or inline actionJSON. Optional.

additionalContents.description: List of additional resources. Optional. These images, js, brushes can be referenced in inline actionJSON or in UXPusing placeholders `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_0__`, `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_1__`, etc. based on their array index.

brushes.description: List of brush resources. External references only. Optional.

patterns.description: List of pattern resources. External references only. Optional.

uxp.description: An UXP plugin script that can be executed, Optional.

image.description: The image input for the actions operation. Required.

options.description: Options configuration for the actions execution. At least one of actions or uxp is required.

outputs.description: List of output asset details. Required. Maximum of 25 outputs allowed.

adjustments.description: Adjustment settings to apply. Must specify exactly one adjustment type (brightness_contrast, hue_saturation, exposure, or color_balance).

isClipped.description: Whether the layer is clipped. Defaults to false when adding layers.

isVisible.description: Whether the layer is visible. Defaults to true when adding layers. Optional for edits.

layerEffects.description: Layer Style effects applied to the layer (e.g. drop shadow). Optional.

pixelMask.description: Pixel mask applied to the layer.

protection.description: Protection flags for the layer (e.g. none, all, transparency, composite, position, artboard_autonest). Defaults to 'none' when adding layers. Optional for edits; omit, null, or empty array [] mean 'don't change'. When 'none' or 'all' is used, the array must contain only that element.

items.description: Protection flag for layer. Used in protection array.

transformMode.description: Transform mode applied to the layer. Defaults to 'none' when adding layers. Optional for edits. Modes: 'none' — applies no scaling. 'fit' — scales the layer uniformly to fit within the canvas bounds while preserving aspect ratio. 'fill' — scales the layer uniformly to fill the canvas bounds while preserving aspect ratio, cropping overflow if the layer's aspect ratio differs from the canvas. 'custom' — applies the exact width and height from the Transform without preserving aspect ratio. Important for text layers: Any mode other than 'none' (or any non-identity scale on the Transform) causes the type engine to render glyphs and leading multiplied by the layer's scale factors. fontSize and lineHeight in CharacterStyle are stored unscaled. The rendered output becomes: fontSize x horizontalScale and lineHeight x verticalScale. To produce text at exact pixel sizes, use transformMode 'none' and avoid scaling Transforms on text layers.

source.description: Source for the additional resource. Must be a URL, Creative Cloud path, or Creative Cloud file ID. Lightroom resources are not supported here. Inline content is not supported. These resources can be referenced in inline actionJSON using placeholders `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_0__`, `__ADDITIONAL_CONTENTS_PATH_1__`, etc.
Source of the font file. Must be a URL, Creative Cloud path, or Creative Cloud file ID. Lightroom resources are not supported for fonts. Required.

Anchor.description: Anchor point coordinates for transformations and positioning.

Apply.description: Inclusive range (from/to) for character or paragraph styling. When present, both 'from' and 'to' are required.

AreaFrame.description: Area text frame defining a bounded rectangular region for text content. Text will wrap within the specified bounds

name.description: Name of the artboard. Optional. Defaults to rendition dimensions (e.g. "1920 x 1080").

source.description: Source of the image. Must be an external file reference (URL, Creative Cloud file ID, or Creative Cloud path). Required.

constrainCrop.description: Whether to constrain crop the straightened image to remove blank edges

enabled.description: Whether auto straighten is enabled. Defaults to false when omitted. Explicit null is invalid.

uprightMode.description: The upright mode to use for straightening. When not specified, performs basic straighten without upright correction (V1 behavior). Specify a mode to enable upright correction.

AutoCropAspectRatio.description: Desired aspect ratio for generated crops.

url.description: Presigned URL for the cropped image. Only present when outputType is 'images'.

x.description: X coordinate of the bounding box.

y.description: Y coordinate of the bounding box.

boundingBoxes.description: List of bounding boxes for the generated crop.

AutoCropImageMediaType.description: The media type of the input image. Supported values are image/jpeg, image/png, and image/webp.

AutoCropInputImage.description: The input image for the auto-crop operation.

AutoCropMode.description: Mode for the auto crop operation. 'smartCrop' and 'subjectCrop' generate crops using aspectRatio with optional zoom. 'fullSceneDetection' and 'objectDetection' detect subjects or objects in the scene.

boundingBoxes.description: Bounding boxes enclosing the detected object in {x, y, width, height} format.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the detected object.

crops.description: Generated crops for the input image.

objects.description: Detected objects in the input image.

subject.description: Subject crops detected in the input image.

AutoCropOutputType.description: Output type for the auto crop operation. 'images' returns cropped images with presigned URLs (default). 'boundingBoxes' returns only bounding box coordinates.

aspectRatio.description: Desired aspect ratio(s) for generated crops. Accepts either a single enum string or an array of up to 20 strings. Allowed only for 'smartCrop' and 'subjectCrop'. When omitted, the service defaults to 1:1. An empty array is treated as absent.

focus.description: Focus labels, ordered by preference, used to prioritize objects during cropping or as detection targets. Required for 'subjectCrop' and 'objectDetection'; must be empty for 'smartCrop' and 'fullSceneDetection'.

zoom.description: Optional zoom level(s) paired with aspectRatio. Accepts either a number or an array of up to 20 numbers in (0, 1]. Must not be sent without aspectRatio. When aspectRatio is an array, zoom may be omitted or must be a matching non-empty array.

url.description: The URL of the resource. Only allow-listed domains are accepted as input URLs (e.g. amazonaws.com, windows.net, dropboxusercontent.com, assets.frame.io, storage.googleapis.com, adobe.io, azureedge.net).

AutoCropUrlResource.description: The source of the input image.

type.description: Type of adjustment. Must match one of the supported types: hue_saturation, brightness_contrast, exposure, or color_balance.

BlendOptions.description: Blend options for layer effects, including opacity settings.

blendMode.description: Blend mode for the layer. Defaults to normal when adding new layers. Optional for edits.

opacity.description: Opacity percentage for the blend effect. Range: 0-100. Defaults to 100 when adding new layers. Optional for edits.

brightness.description: The adjustment layer's brightness. Range: -150 to 150. Defaults to 0 when adding new layers. Optional for edits

contrast.description: The adjustment layer's contrast. Range: -150 to 150. Defaults to 0 when adding new layers. Optional for edits

BrushResource.description: Single brush resource (.abr, etc.). When present, the 'source' field is required.

source.description: Source for the brush resource. Must be a URL, Creative Cloud path, or Creative Cloud file ID. Lightroom resources are not supported for brushes. Inline content is not supported.

autoLeading.description: When true, line height is calculated automatically based on the font size. When false, custom lineHeight is applied. Optional.

capsOption.description: Caps option for text. Optional. Default is normal_caps.

fontAlpha.description: Font alpha/transparency value. Optional. Default is 1.0.

fontColor.description: Font color settings. Optional. Default is black in RGB.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels. Optional. Default is 30.

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing in pixels. Optional. Default is 0.

lineHeight.description: Line height (leading) in pixels. Optional. This value represents the unscaled leading stored on the character style. If the text layer carries a non-identity transform, for example because the bounding box was resized in Photoshop, the rendered leading becomes lineHeight x the layer's vertical scale factor. To get exact rendered pixel leading, ensure the layer has no residual scaling (transformMode: none with no scaling Transform applied), or pre-divide the desired rendered leading by the layer's current vertical scale. The same scaling behavior applies to fontSize.

syntheticBold.description: Whether to apply synthetic bold. Optional. Default is false.

syntheticItalic.description: Whether to apply synthetic italic. Optional. Default is false.

underline.description: Whether to apply underline. Optional. Default is false.

CharacterStyleRange.description: Character style range defining styling for specific text ranges.

apply.description: Range of characters to apply styling to. Optional.

highlightLevels.description: Array of 3 integers for highlight levels. Each value must be between -100 and 100. Defaults to [0, 0, 0] when adding new layers. Optional for edits

midtoneLevels.description: Array of 3 integers for midtone levels. Each value must be between -100 and 100. Defaults to [0, 0, 0] when adding new layers. Optional for edits

preserveLuminosity.description: Whether to preserve luminosity. Defaults to true when adding new layers. Optional for edits

shadowLevels.description: Array of 3 integers for shadow levels. Each value must be between -100 and 100. Defaults to [0, 0, 0] when adding new layers. Optional for edits

artboardSpacing.description: Horizontal spacing in pixels between each artboard. Defaults to 50. Optional.

images.description: List of input images for the artboard. Each image must have a source with an external file reference (URL, Creative Cloud file ID, or Creative Cloud path). Required.

outputs.description: List of output asset details. Each output specifies destination and output options. Maximum of 25 outputs allowed.

edits.description: Edits to be applied to the input asset. Optional.

fontOptions.description: Font options to be applied. Optional.

creativeCloudFileId.description: The file ID of the asset in Creative Cloud. Required. Must start with 'urn:aaid' (case-insensitive).

hide.description: When true, hides pixels outside the crop bounds (non-destructive). When false, permanently deletes pixels outside the crop bounds (destructive). Defaults to false.

value.description: The value of the dimension. Must be greater than or equal to 0.

transformMode.description: Transform mode applied to the layer. Defaults to 'none' when adding layers. Optional for edits. Modes: 'none' — applies no scaling. 'fit' — scales the layer uniformly to fit within the canvas bounds while preserving aspect ratio. 'fill' — scales the layer uniformly to fill the canvas bounds while preserving aspect ratio, cropping overflow if the layer's aspect ratio differs from the canvas. 'custom' — applies the exact width and height from the Transform without preserving aspect ratio. Important for text layers: Any mode other than 'none' (or any non-identity scale on the Transform) causes the type engine to render glyphs and leading multiplied by the layer's scale factors. fontSize and lineHeight in CharacterStyle are stored unscaled. The rendered output becomes: fontSize x horizontalScale and lineHeight x verticalScale. To produce text at exact pixel sizes, use transformMode 'none' and avoid scaling Transforms on text layers.

name.description: Name of the contour preset. Required. Only "Custom" is supported currently.

Trim.description: Options for trimming a document, specifying the basis for the trim operation.

trimUpon.description: The basis for the trim operation (background or transparent). Optional.

storageType.description: Storage type for the destination. Optional.

url.description: Pre-signed URL for external storage. Must be HTTPS. Required.
The pre-signed URL of the resource. Required.

UrlResourceInput.description: URL resource input. References a resource via a pre-signed URL.

UxpResource.description: UXP plugin script resource. Requires source (external file reference or inline script content).

source.description: Source for the UXP script. Can be external file reference or inline script content. UXP scripts can use the placeholder `__UXP_OUTPUT_PATH__` which will be replaced at runtime with the directory path for script output files. Example usage: `const outputPath = '__UXP_OUTPUT_PATH__'; const outputFile = path.join(outputPath, 'uxpOutput.json');`

ValidationError.description: Represents a single validation error with error code and message

error_code.description: The error code for this specific validation error

message.description: Human-readable string describing this specific validation error

XmpInput.description: XMP metadata input. Requires source (external file reference). Inline content is not supported.

masks.description: List of mask inputs. Optional. Each mask contains a source file reference and digest for dictionary lookup.

orientation.description: XMP orientation value to override image orientation. Optional.

source.description: The resource input for the XMP. Required. Must be an external file reference (URL, Creative Cloud path, or Creative Cloud file ID). Inline content is not supported.

preset.description: Optional. When true, produces a portable Lightroom preset instead of a plain XMP sidecar of the applied edit parameters. Default: false.

output.description: The options for the output image.

trim.description: If true, the image returned is cropped to the cutout border. Transparent pixels are removed.

colorDecontamination.description: If the value is greater than 0, automatically removes colored reflections that have been left on the main subject by the background.

red.description: The red value of the color.

green.description: The green value of the color.

blue.description: The blue value of the color.

alpha.description: The transparency value. 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque.

source.description: The source path for the input image. Dimensions of the image should not be greater than 6000px X 6000px. The image media type must be `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, or `image/tiff`.

url.description:
The URL of the resource. Only these listed domains are accepted in the request:
  • amazonaws.com
  • windows.net
  • dropboxusercontent.com
  • assets.frame.io
  • storage.googleapis.com

RemoveBgOutputImageMediaType.description: The media type of the output image. By default this will match the input source file format.
